recipe.visualDefinition: A central, symmetrical metallic sculpture consisting of chrome mechanical wings attached to a stylized ribcage, floating against a dramatic sky. The right wing is engulfed in ethereal blue flames, while the background transitions from a bright, heavenly glow on the left to dark, stormy clouds on the right.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between the mechanical structure and the asymmetrical application of blue fire
Contrast between the cold, hard chrome texture and the soft, fluid cloud background
Vertical alignment of the central subject with the top and bottom text elements
Light-to-dark gradient background mirroring the 'fall' narrative
coreInvariants: Chrome/metallic material for the central object
Blue flame effect localized to one side

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The mechanical wing-ribcage hybrid is centered horizontally and vertically, occupying the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central junction where the wings meet the ribcage serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright center, follows the span of the wings outward, is drawn to the blue flames on the right, and then moves vertically to the text at the top and bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space provided by the sky, creating a sense of isolation and scale.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated greys and whites in the clouds and chrome.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and navy in the lower right quadrant.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant cyan and electric blue for the flames.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value/low saturation in the upper left, low value/low saturation in the lower right, with high saturation localized in the blue fire.

letterConstructionRules: Small caps for the top title
Clean, modern sans-serif for the bottom name
Subtle metallic or stone-like texture applied to glyphs

composition.relationshipToImage: Floating in the bright sky area
Floating in the dark cloud area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a traditional serif for the title and a modern geometric sans for the artist name.
graphicDevices: Outer glow on the blue flames

preserve: Small caps for the top text

candidateDirections.reason: Classic cinematic serif feel for the top title.
Clean, modern geometric presence for the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 3D chrome sculpture of mechanical feathered wings attached to a metallic ribcage. The object is centered. The background is a dramatic sky with white clouds on the left and dark, stormy navy clouds on the right. The right wing is engulfed in ethereal, wispy blue flames. High-contrast lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the title in the top center using a small-caps serif font with wide tracking. Add the artist name in the bottom center using a bold geometric sans-serif font with extra-wide tracking. Both should be white or light grey.

verificationChecks: Is the chrome texture highly reflective?
Are the blue flames only on the right side?
Is the background split between light and dark?
Is the text tracking sufficiently wide?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the mechanical wing joints
mustRedesign: Specific artist names or album titles
Any unique logos present in the original
postGenerationChecks: Verify the blue fire has a 'ghostly' or 'ethereal' quality
Ensure the text is perfectly centered
Confirm the background gradient is smooth without banding
recipe.reuseFormula: Central metallic hybrid object + split-tone atmospheric background + wide-tracked minimalist typography.
